##### Project general facts

Palm Central Private Residences is a refined waterfront development designed around a serene resort-style lifestyle. Rising from the island’s central spine between Fronds M and N, the three elegant buildings feature stepped forms, soft tones, and flowing architecture inspired by the sea and horizon. The development offers 1- to 5-bedroom residences, including exclusive townhouses and penthouses with private pools, all designed to maximise natural light and panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf.

The development offers a comprehensive range of resort-inspired amenities focused on wellness, leisure, and family living. Residents can enjoy direct beach access, an infinity pool with Jacuzzi, gym and yoga studio, games and multipurpose rooms, and dedicated indoor and outdoor children’s play areas. A beach lounge, cinema, outdoor dining areas, event lawn, and padel courts create vibrant spaces for relaxation and socialising, while lush gardens, elegant lobbies, and private garages add comfort and convenience.

The residences feature contemporary interiors with open layouts, warm textures, and natural materials including wood, stone, and glass. Floor-to-ceiling windows create a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor spaces, while spacious terraces and balconies extend the living areas towards the sea. Modern finishing using high-quality materials complements the understated coastal aesthetic. The kitchens are equipped, while the residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Palm Jebel Ali is a stunning man-made island located off the coast of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Resembling a palm tree when viewed from above, this ambitious project is a testament to Dubai's innovation and engineering prowess.

The development on Palm Jebel Ali is set to include a wide range of residential, commercial, and leisure facilities. It is designed to be a self-sustaining community, with infrastructure that includes roads, bridges, and utilities. The island is planned to be connected to the mainland of Dubai via a bridge and accessible through a monorail system.

Palm Jebel Ali is a testament to Dubai's dedication to creating unique and luxurious living environments. With its stunning location and ambitious vision, it promises to offer a lifestyle that blends natural beauty, modern amenities, and the allure of coastal living. As it nears completion, it represents an exciting chapter in Dubai's ongoing development and innovation.
